The present appeal is filed under Section 374(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (CrPC),
challenging the judgment dated 05.01.2024 and order dated 22.01.2024, passed by the learned Special Judge (PC Act) (CBI), Rouse Avenue District Courts, New Delhi, in CC No. 98/2019.

The appellant company was also sentenced to pay a total fine of 1 Crore.

5. The learned counsel for the appellant submits that the learned NCLT had initiated CIRP against the appellant company and the Insolvency Resolution Professional was also appointed prior to passing of the impugned orders.

6. She submits that in terms of the provisions of Section 32A of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (IBC) read with Section 14 of the IBC, no fine could have been imposed on the appellant company.
7. Issue notice.
8. Ms. Tarannum Cheema, learned counsel for the respondent, accepts notice and seeks time to file a reply.

9. Let the reply be filed within a period of three weeks from date.
10.
The recovery of fine as imposed by the learned Trial Court by order dated 22.01.2024 is stayed in relation to the appellant till the next date of hearing.
AMIT MAHAJAN, J APRIL 16, 2024 'KDK'
